kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نكتئب (form VIII)
# نَكْتَئِبُ (naktaʔibu) /nak.ta.ʔi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَأَبَ (iktaʔaba)
# نَكْتَئِبَ (naktaʔiba) /nak.ta.ʔi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَأَبَ (iktaʔaba)
# نَكْتَئِبْ (naktaʔib) /nak.ta.ʔib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِكْتَأَبَ (iktaʔaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
